name: Zolpidem
summary: Zolpidem is a nonbenzodiazepine sedative-hypnotic medication that positively modulates GABA-A receptor signaling. This profile remains research-only while short-term insomnia efficacy, complex sleep behavior, next-day impairment, CNS-depressant interaction, and regulatory evidence is assembled and reviewed.

primary_effects_or_targets: GABA-A receptor positive modulation; central nervous system sedation
